integrity: Evidence includes a self-contained enumerator and exact captured outputs. Numerical checks are finite and do not replace the all-integer proof. Scientific review is same-model only; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The known minimum-fort-size-four theorem is credited as an antecedent, not as a new result. The coefficient formula is for rook graphs, with a degree-five gap only when both side lengths are at least six and the explicit sixth coefficient only when both are at least seven; no efficient bit-complexity guarantee. An unindexed equivalent enumeration is possible.
title: Fort polynomial of rook graphs and its degree-five gap
